_comment: Phase 1 provisions with synchronous_standby_names = '*', which is the state the cluster is actually in today. '*' matches any application name, so it resolves to FIRST 1 (whichever standby connects first) -- a policy with no named candidates. Phase 2 then applies the real change, to an explicitly named ANY 1 over all four nodes.
_comment_pgbackrest: pgBackRest encrypts its repository by default (repo_cipher_type aes-256-cbc) and refuses to configure without a passphrase. A throwaway value here; a real deployment supplies this from its secret store.
